facts.text: Sonoma State houses the Wine Business Institute, created in 1996 in partnership with the wine industry to offer specialized business degrees and industry research.

sources.title: Wine Business Institute at Sonoma State University
sources.quote: Established in 1996 through a partnership between the wine industry and Sonoma State University's School of Business, WBI conducts cutting-edge research that shapes industry best practices and enhances its program curriculum.
